theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s' := s
  let t' := t
  obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨y₀⟩ := ht
  let b := classical.some (exists_between x₀ y₀)
  use b
  · intro x
    intro hx
    have h1 : x ∈ s := hx
    have h2 : x < b := classical.some_spec (exists_between x₀ y₀) (lt_trans (H x hx) (lt_classical.some (exists_between x₀ y₀)))
  · intro y
    intro hy
    have h1 : y ∈ t := hy
    have h2 : b < y := classical.some_spec (exists_between x₀ y₀) (lt_classical.some (exists_between x₀ y₀))
